text:
jessica.f: FYI we had a race in the invoice serial allocator. Two drafts generated with the same invoice number INV-2026-0503 but for different tenants. One of them also lost the GPU line in the draft (it shows total but missing compute_gpu_hours).

nate.s: omg. which tenants? are PDFs already sent?

jessica.f: Tenant A (acme-analytics) and Tenant B (orchid-ml). PDFs not yet emailed — still in draft. found during pre-send QA.

liam.q: likely the incremental sequence service returned the same value for two concurrent workers; we saw a failed lock on the numbering table last hour. I can patch to use advisory locks.

billing-bot: Reconciliation check: batch=rb-20260503-3, drafts=872, anomalies_detected=2 (duplicate_invoice_number, missing_line_item).

audra_revops: revenue ops impact? This will change recognized revenue if we reissue after close. Need manual memo for finance.

jessica.f: The missing line appears in the draft rendering step: compute_gpu_hours present in charges table but not in PDF table. suspect rounding filter suppressed a tiny line item (0.004 token-hours * price rounding) and our render pipeline drops any line with zero display_amount.

greg.ops: quick detection queries:
```
-- find duplicate invoice numbers in last 7 days
SELECT invoice_number, count(*) as hits, array_agg(id) as ids
FROM invoices
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY invoice_number
HAVING count(*) > 1;

-- find invoices where compute line exists but PDF rendering amount is null
SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, cl.amount_cents, pdf.line_present
FROM invoices i
JOIN compute_lines cl ON cl.invoice_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN pdf_lines pdf ON pdf.invoice_id = i.id AND pdf.code = 'compute_gpu_hours'
WHERE cl.amount_cents > 0 AND (pdf.line_present IS NULL OR pdf.line_present = false);
```

nate.s: thanks greg. liam, patch + deploy? we should also block outbound emails until we fix drafts.

liam.q: rolling a hotfix to grab pg_advisory_lock on serial generator now. will also add a render guard to include tiny nonzero amounts and log any rounding drops. ETA 30m.

billing-bot: Action created: tas-4901 (label: invoice-serial-race). Assigned to @liam.q.

audra_revops: once patched, finance needs: 1) list of affected invoice ids, 2) manual credit/journal entries planned, 3) a one-paragraph customer note for the two tenants. i'll sign off.

jessica.f: drafted customer note (short):
"We discovered duplicate invoice drafts generated for your account during our invoice generation process. Only one final invoice will be issued; drafts will be cancelled. If you received a draft PDF, please disregard. We will follow up with the final invoice and a detailed explanation. Apologies for the confusion."

nate.s: also add internal audit note: why serial allocator failed, what lock behavior changed, who approved hotfix, and a timeline.

liam.q: patch deployed. serial allocator now uses advisory locks. reran the duplicate detection query; only the two drafts remain. regenerating both drafts now and blocking outbound.

billing-bot: Regeneration job queued: regen_job=rg-20260503-21, targets=2. Outbound email paused for batch rb-20260503-3.

greg.ops: regen finished. both invoices now have unique numbers INV-2026-0503 and INV-2026-0504. compute_gpu_hours line present for both. PDF previews uploaded to /shared/finance/previews/20260503/.

audra_revops: finance approved reissue. i'll prepare rev memo and customer emails. Please attach audit note to tas-4901.

jessica.f: closing loop. thanks team. reopen if any customer sees a draft email.
